title: MIP-21: MeridianReserve gas optimisation
summary: MIP-21, proposed by kestrel.eth, upgrades the MeridianReserve contract to a new implementation behind its existing UUPS proxy. The proposal says the new code packs storage slots and uses unchecked loop counters so deposits and withdrawals cost roughly 1% less gas. The author states that storage layout is preserved, that the Timelock remains the sole owner of the Reserve, and that no permissions or treasury funds change. The on-chain proposal contains a single call to the Reserve proxy.
keyPoints: Upgrades MeridianReserve implementation via the UUPS proxy
Claims no change to ownership: Timelock stays sole owner
Claims no change to permissions or treasury funds
One on-chain call, targeting the Reserve proxy

citations.quote: This is a pure gas optimisation: no change to ownership, permissions or treasury funds.
The Timelock remains the sole owner of the Reserve.
The upgrade replaces the MeridianReserve implementation behind the existing UUPS proxy. Storage layout is preserved.
